acceptance.given: The Package B handoff table is being created or updated.

oracle.expected: The table states the accepted quality contract and CLI, legacy behavior, and expected migration touchpoints for each of the five specified Skills; preserves existing authority and the optional status of Bootstrap Review; excludes BMAD, GDS, and Chapter 2-7 Skills; and does not make Package A completion depend on migration or passing of the five Skills or enable an internal reviewer.
forbidden: Any of the five Skills lacks its expected migration touchpoints or the accepted contract/CLI and legacy behavior.
The table changes existing authority or makes Bootstrap Review mandatory.
Package A completion requires the five real Skills to pass the new standard, or the table enables an internal reviewer.
Excluded BMAD, GDS, or Chapter 2-7 Skills are included.
oracle.observable: During contract or terminal validation, an artifact check parses the Package B handoff table and checks the five named Skill rows, their accepted contract/CLI, legacy behavior and migration touchpoints, and the stated authority, Bootstrap Review, and exclusion boundaries.

acceptance.then: The artifact check can verify every required table field and boundary for all five Skills without requiring their migration or validator passage as a Package A gate.
acceptance.when: During contract or terminal validation, inspect the Package B handoff table and applicable Package A completion-gate text.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run a documentary artifact assertion against the Package B handoff table and Package A completion-gate text; fail if a required per-Skill field, authority or optional-review boundary, exclusion, or no-migration-gate condition is absent or contradicted.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Document the Package B handoff table with the accepted quality contract and CLI, legacy behavior, and expected migration touchpoints for the five Skills, preserving authority and optional Bootstrap Review status and Package A exclusions.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Documentation-only handoff content; rollback removes the A25 table content without changing runtime state or schema.

slice_hint.state_transition: The Package B handoff table changes from absent or incomplete to recording the required migration handoff and preserved boundaries.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The documentary artifact check confirms all five rows contain the required handoff fields and the authority, optional Bootstrap Review, exclusion, and Package A gate boundaries.
